description: Hippocampal buffer and sleep consolidation (devsim/sleep.py). Every value is a design default - unverified: chosen so a typical agent promotes about 15%, gists about 50% and drops about 35% of a mixed-arousal buffer (docs/SLEEP_IMPLEMENTATION.md). None is a cited effect size. Each parameter carries its allowed range or choices.

min_awake_hours.note: design default - unverified; hours awake after which the next time step counts as one sleep opportunity

q_base.note: design default - unverified; sleep quality Q of an agent with neutral dials and a calm buffer

q_floor.note: design default - unverified; lowest Q (chronic insomnia)

a_dysreg.note: design default - unverified; Q loss at full dysregulation

a_mood.note: design default - unverified; Q loss at the lowest mood baseline (shift -1)

a_threat.note: design default - unverified; Q loss at full threat sensitivity

a_stress.note: design default - unverified; Q loss when every buffered experience had arousal 1

threat_gain.note: design default - unverified; extra arousal weight of negative entries at full threat sensitivity

k_arousal.note: design default - unverified; trace-weight gain per unit (effective) arousal

k_rehearsal.note: design default - unverified; trace-weight gain per ln(1 + rehearsals)

k_self.note: design default - unverified; trace-weight gain per unit self-relevance (appraised importance)

k_novelty.note: design default - unverified; trace-weight gain per unit novelty

novelty_default.note: design default - unverified; novelty of a non-routine experience (a habituated repeat gets 1/(1+exposures))

lambda_lability.note: design default - unverified; per-day decay of an unconsolidated trace, for retrieval and for the delay before first sleep

sigma.note: design default - unverified; scale of the standard-logistic noise in the triage score

theta_drop.note: design default - unverified; triage scores below this are dropped (calibrated to ~35% dropped)

theta_episodic.note: design default - unverified; triage scores at or above this become episodic memories (calibrated to ~15% promoted)

age_decline_start.note: design default - unverified; age in years where the consolidation multiplier starts its linear decline

age_decline_end.note: design default - unverified; age where the multiplier reaches age_floor

age_floor.note: design default - unverified; age multiplier at and after age_decline_end

rt_strength.note: design default - unverified; capacity loss at reality testing 0 (capacity = 1 - rt_strength * (1 - reality_testing))

promote_stability_exponent.note: design default - unverified; promoted or new-gist stability = encoding stability * w_eff ** exponent

sim_threshold.note: design default - unverified; participant-and-word overlap needed to merge a gist into an existing memory

sim_threshold_embedding.note: design default - unverified; BGE cosine needed to merge when local embeddings are in use (related pairs measured ~0.7)

gist_stability_gain.note: design default - unverified; a merged gist multiplies the matched memory's stability by 1 + gain

encoding_penalty.note: design default - unverified; when true, poor sleep lowers the stability of memories encoded in the following awake period

encoding_penalty_strength.note: design default - unverified; encoding multiplier = 1 - strength * (1 - last Q)

summarizer.note: design default - unverified; gist text from key fields, or batched local-model calls when a live Lifetime attaches the model

llm_batch_size.note: design default - unverified; memories per summarizer call
